selection: All remaining seed records, P041–P090, in stable ID order. Targeted source lookups, not a systematic database search.
reviewer: Codex AI-assisted preliminary triage; human adjudication pending for all 90 records.
decision_rule: Advance on an explicit relevance signal; retain unclear for scope or access questions. No missing evidence is treated as an exclusion. Selected passages support only their recorded findings; all feature codes remain provisional.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract
records.criterion_3: Posterior uncertainty and calibration for hyperspectral reconstruction
records.evidence: HSDiff uses a diffusion image prior with optics-encoded measurements for hyperspectral posterior inference and evaluates uncertainty calibration across optical encodings.
records.full_text_question: Are the optical operators known, estimated or misspecified? Extract calibration units and tests beyond the trained optical family.

records.basis: Author preprint abstract and targeted discussion/limitations, sections 9–10
records.criterion_3: Residual-based reliability certification and selective replacement of a baseline
records.evidence: The method compares learned and baseline error certificates derived under a stability assumption. It falls back when certificate dominance fails. This is deterministic certification, not joint image/operator posterior inference. The limitations identify conservative radii, fixed-candidate independent collocation and controlled numerical validation.
records.full_text_question: Verify the stability constants, admissible class and operational radius. Certificate dominance does not imply lower actual error than the baseline; test whether the guarantee survives an uncertain or misspecified observation operator.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract; existing journal citation retained
records.criterion_3: Adaptation to changing or partially known forward models
records.evidence: Two adaptation procedures update learned reconstruction when the forward operator changes, without requiring new ground-truth training images; applications include deblurring, super-resolution and MRI.
records.full_text_question: Which operator changes are supplied to the method, which are inferred, and how are adaptation data separated from evaluation?

records.basis: Complete institutional publication abstract and DOI metadata
records.criterion_3: Joint image/PSF estimation without test-time PSF access
records.evidence: An adversarial-learning reconstruction method estimates the image and point-spread function across lensless camera PSFs, removing the requirement for a supplied test-time PSF.
records.full_text_question: Are evaluated cameras or PSF families genuinely held out, and is uncertainty propagated beyond a point PSF estimate?

records.basis: Complete official NeurIPS proceedings abstract
records.criterion_3: Blind joint reconstruction with image and operator priors
records.evidence: Block-coordinate plug-and-play updates use learned denoisers for both image and operator variables, with convergence analysis and MRI/deblurring evaluations.
records.full_text_question: Extract the convergence assumptions and distinguish stationary-point analysis from statistical operator uncertainty or robustness to an incorrect operator family.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract and SIAM citation
records.criterion_3: Operator-family adaptation and blind reconstruction
records.evidence: Training over an operator family supports adaptive and blind reconstruction in settings including MRI calibration, tilted tomography and Fresnel propagation.
records.full_text_question: Separate interpolation within the training operator family from extrapolation or wrong-family mismatch. The 2022 preprint and 2024 journal record are one lineage.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract; OpenReview access challenged
records.criterion_3: Explicit forward-model residual correction inside unrolled/equilibrium models
records.evidence: An untrained instance-specific residual network compensates model discrepancy while reconstructing within learned unrolled or deep-equilibrium architectures; linear and nonlinear cases are studied.
records.full_text_question: What prevents the correction from absorbing image structure or measurement noise, and which mismatch families and convergence assumptions are tested?

records.basis: Complete official ICLR proceedings abstract
records.criterion_3: Posterior-sampling sensitivity to measurement and prior mismatch
records.evidence: The paper bounds changes in plug-and-play Langevin posterior sampling under both measurement-model and denoiser mismatch, with Gaussian-mixture and deblurring assessments.
records.full_text_question: Which model assumptions support the posterior-distance bound? Does it imply calibrated intervals or selective-output reliability under structured acquisition mismatch?

records.basis: Publisher-indexed title and abstract excerpt; IEEE PDF retrieval failed and HAL challenged
records.criterion_3: Explicit correction of acquisition micro-vibrations in pushbroom satellite imaging
records.evidence: The indexed primary-source excerpt identifies estimation of micro-vibrations and correction of their image effects. A complete abstract or technical assessment was not obtained; no performance or uncertainty claim is verified here.
records.full_text_question: Retrieve the full text to verify the physical parameterization, motion identification, synthetic versus real evidence and any uncertainty analysis.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract and coauthor publication listing
records.criterion_3: Blind image/operator inference with text-conditioned latent diffusion priors
records.evidence: LADiBI uses text-guided image and operator priors with iterative flexible-operator estimation, including nonlinear degradation. The author listing identifies a NeurIPS workshop, not the main conference.
records.full_text_question: Check prompt sensitivity, operator constraints and identifiability. Retained peer-review flag is legacy metadata; workshop review procedure was not independently verified.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract; journal lineage from the existing audit
records.criterion_3: Adaptive unknown-operator calibration during diffusion-bridge MRI reconstruction
records.evidence: ADOBI adapts an unknown operator while using a conditional diffusion bridge to reconstruct MRI images, emphasizing efficient inference.
records.full_text_question: Does coil calibration propagate operator uncertainty or yield a point estimate? Test the distinction between imperfect parameters and a wrong acquisition family.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract and coauthor ICML acceptance announcement
records.criterion_3: Structured unknown nonlinear forward-operator estimation
records.evidence: CaMB-Diff imposes monotonicity through cascaded Bernstein operators to estimate dynamic-range compression within a diffusion reconstruction framework. The coauthor announces ICML 2026 acceptance; the full OpenReview record remains access-limited.
records.full_text_question: Distinguish radiometric dynamic-range compression from image/video codec artifacts. Assess identifiability, saturation and validity when the true operator violates monotonicity.

records.basis: Complete publisher abstract and publication metadata
records.criterion_3: Unknown and time-varying multi-degradation video restoration
records.evidence: FaverNet uses frequency-sensitive degradation conditioning and prompt-guided temporal alignment across conventional and weather degradations.
records.full_text_question: Compare its study lineage and experiments with P026 AverNet before counting independent evidence. Verify temporal/compound settings and complete code/data release rather than infer release from a link.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract
records.criterion_3: Joint low-light and motion-blur restoration with real paired acquisition
records.evidence: ELEDNet uses event/image temporal and cross-modal information; a beam-splitter acquisition setup supplies paired low-light blurred and reference video.
records.full_text_question: Which information depends on an event sensor unavailable in ordinary CCTV? Verify pairing, exposure differences and cross-device generalization.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract
records.criterion_3: Joint low-light enhancement and deblurring
records.evidence: LEDNet jointly addresses darkness and blur using the LOL-Blur paired dataset, with synthetic and real-image evaluations.
records.full_text_question: How are blur, exposure, noise and processing ordered in synthesis? Determine which real examples have trustworthy references.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract
records.criterion_3: Blind real-world video super-resolution under complex degradation
records.evidence: RealBasicVSR studies degradation propagation, pre-cleaning and training tradeoffs, and introduces the VideoLQ real-world benchmark.
records.full_text_question: Separate perceptual gains on unpaired videos from faithful detail recovery. Verify held-out cameras/codecs and which degradations are jointly simulated.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract
records.criterion_3: Compound synthetic image/video acquisition and compression degradation
records.evidence: The synthesis pipeline combines shuffled blur, noise, downsampling, pixel binning and image/video compression to train blind video super-resolution.
records.full_text_question: Do the tested codecs and degradation orders leave the training distribution? Non-reference quality scores alone do not establish recovery of true detail.

records.basis: Complete institutional publication abstract and DOI metadata
records.criterion_3: Real acquisition mismatch and cross-camera video restoration
records.evidence: A dual-camera phone dataset supplies real low/high-resolution video pairs; decomposition-based learning addresses pair misalignment and color differences, with cross-camera evaluation.
records.full_text_question: Quantify reference alignment and color bias, device separation and whether errors attributed to reconstruction could arise from imperfect ground truth.

records.basis: Complete author abstract and publisher journal metadata
records.criterion_3: Real blurred/sharp video acquisition and cross-dataset generalization
records.evidence: BSD provides beam-splitter paired video for evaluating recurrent deblurring with spatiotemporal features and attention.
records.full_text_question: Check acquisition timing, alignment, reference quality and cross-dataset splits. Link any earlier conference report to the journal study before synthesis.

records.basis: Publisher abstract and opening full-text context
records.criterion_3: CCTV distortion and downstream quality assessment are relevant, but criterion 2 needs adjudication
records.evidence: CQAD combines real CCTV reference images with synthetic distortion variants and subjective ratings. Its central task is image-quality assessment rather than an inverse reconstruction method.
records.full_text_question: Does this dataset provide a reconstruction-relevant evaluation under criterion 2/4, or belong only in contextual background? Real reference CCTV frames are not automatically clean scene truth.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract and official repository
records.criterion_3: Task-driven super-resolution across surveillance viewpoint/domain shift
records.evidence: S3-CLIP combines video super-resolution and CLIP-based person retrieval across ground/aerial views in a WACV workshop challenge setting.
records.full_text_question: Which task improvements are caused by restored evidence rather than prior bias? Person-retrieval accuracy is not a certificate of image-detail fidelity.

records.basis: Complete official PMLR abstract
records.criterion_3: Conformal risk control for diffusion reconstruction uncertainty
records.evidence: K-RCPS optimizes multidimensional prediction intervals for entrywise reconstruction risk, evaluating natural-image and CT denoising.
records.full_text_question: Extract the risk unit, calibration assumptions and coverage statement; check whether any guarantee addresses changing or misspecified operators.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract and existing ECCV lineage
records.criterion_3: Task-level uncertainty calibration and adaptive measurement stopping
records.evidence: Conformal intervals quantify a downstream task output associated with the unknown image; interval width can guide additional measurements in MRI.
records.full_text_question: Distinguish stopping acquisition from abstaining on reconstructed content. Verify exchangeability and whether task-specific coverage survives operator shift.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract and existing journal lineage
records.criterion_3: Deterministic/stochastic inexact operators and reconstruction uncertainty
records.evidence: The nanoCT study compares classical methods, a U-Net and conditional invertible reconstruction under inexact forward operators, including uncertainty assessment.
records.full_text_question: Identify the stochastic operator model, image uncertainty measure and calibration evidence. Mismatch plus uncertainty is already studied; wrong-family reliability needs specific verification.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract and existing journal lineage
records.criterion_3: Conformalized aleatoric/epistemic reconstruction uncertainty
records.evidence: A generative image posterior is combined with Bayesian-network or ensemble uncertainty and conformal calibration for computational imaging tasks.
records.full_text_question: Aleatoric and epistemic components do not automatically mean image and operator posteriors. Extract the latent variables, calibration target and operator-shift tests.

records.basis: Complete official Springer proceedings abstract
records.criterion_3: Self-supervised uncertainty calibration without clean ground truth
records.evidence: The method uses Stein's unbiased risk estimate with conformal prediction to calibrate reconstruction uncertainty from noisy data for linear imaging problems.
records.full_text_question: Which noise and operator assumptions make the risk estimate valid? Check whether the calibration remains valid when those assumptions are wrong. Ground-truth-free calibration alone is not a new contribution.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract
records.criterion_3: Spatially adaptive conformal reconstruction intervals and hallucination examples
records.evidence: QUTCC learns quantiles for conformal prediction intervals in denoising, MRI and phase microscopy; its stated guarantee is pixel-marginal coverage.
records.full_text_question: Separate pixel-marginal from conditional or whole-image coverage. Does elevated uncertainty detect unsupported details reliably under operator shift, rather than in selected examples?

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract; shorter seed conference title retained
records.criterion_3: Correction of degradation mismatch for pretrained super-resolution
records.evidence: A low-resolution correction filter adapts observations to a pretrained super-resolver's assumed degradation; the work also considers blind filter estimation.
records.full_text_question: Verify the supplied versus estimated kernel assumptions and the publication lineage of the longer preprint title. Use 2020 conference publication for the review window.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract; existing journal citation retained
records.criterion_3: Joint blind image/kernel recovery using generative priors
records.evidence: Separate image and blur generators support alternating latent-variable optimization; variants address limitations of a fixed generator's image range.
records.full_text_question: Verify journal/preprint lineage and identifiability when the image or kernel lies outside the generator range. A deterministic latent optimum is not an uncertainty estimate.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract; seed WACV venue not independently rechecked
records.criterion_3: Multi-degradation and time-varying compound video restoration
records.evidence: Language-grounded degradation representations guide video restoration, with a distilled inference component and tests including time-varying composite degradation.
records.full_text_question: Extract the exact held-out combinations, temporal changes and inference inputs. Natural-language guidance plus changing compound degradation is an existing direction.

records.basis: Specific official proceedings title located; CVF HTML/PDF access failed; complete abstract unavailable
records.criterion_3: Title explicitly identifies restoration with unknown degradations
records.evidence: The title establishes a conservative scope signal for all-in-one restoration using adaptive degradation-specific filters. No technical or performance claim is verified from the unavailable abstract.
records.full_text_question: Retrieve the complete paper and verify how degradation is inferred, whether combinations are simultaneous and how unknown degradation is operationally tested.

records.basis: Official PDF abstract/opening page; a text search for unknown yielded no match
records.criterion_3: Degradation perception is explicit, but the qualifying mismatch/reliability setting needs verification
records.evidence: PromptRestorer couples restoration with a degradation-perception branch and prompting modules across several restoration tasks. This alone does not establish a single blind, compound or OOD evaluation.
records.full_text_question: Are task models trained separately, and do experiments explicitly address any criterion-3 condition? A missing keyword is not an exclusion reason.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract and existing ECCV lineage
records.criterion_3: Automatic unknown-degradation detection and all-in-one restoration
records.evidence: AutoDIR combines vision-language quality/degradation analysis with structurally corrected latent diffusion restoration and text control.
records.full_text_question: Which unknown or combined degradations are tested independently of training, and how is structural or semantic fidelity measured?

records.basis: Complete author abstract, project page and official ICLR slides title

metadata.Title: Controlling Vision-Language Models for Multi-Task Image Restoration

records.criterion_3: Unknown-degradation representation for unified restoration
records.evidence: DA-CLIP predicts degradation and clean-content embeddings to guide restoration. Current author/proceedings materials use Multi-Task in the title; Universal persists in older repository BibTeX and is retained as an alias in the audit.
records.full_text_question: Distinguish a dataset mixing different degradation classes from images with simultaneously compounded corruption. Verify the final citation against the accepted paper.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract
records.criterion_3: Adaptive all-in-one restoration with unseen-task transfer
records.evidence: MPerceiver uses predicted degradation and multimodal diffusion prompts with detail refinement, including zero/few-shot evaluation beyond its training task set.
records.full_text_question: What adaptation data or instructions are supplied for unseen tasks, and is fidelity measured against observation-supported detail rather than perceptual appearance?

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract
records.criterion_3: Instruction-conditioned restoration across unknown degradation types
records.evidence: InstructIR uses human instructions to guide a shared restoration system across noise, blur, rain, haze and low-light tasks.
records.full_text_question: Which degradation information is provided by the instruction? Multiple tasks alone do not demonstrate simultaneous compound corruption or reliable recovery under shift.

records.basis: Official NeurIPS PDF abstract and opening page
records.criterion_3: Identification and ordered treatment of compound image degradation
records.evidence: RestoreAgent uses a multimodal language model to diagnose degradation and select/order restoration tools for compound inputs.
records.full_text_question: How are tool-order decisions evaluated, and can the controller reject unsupported enhancement? Reported quality or expert comparisons are author results, not independent validation.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract; seed proceedings PDF retrieval failed
records.criterion_3: Generative real-world restoration with degradation-aware conditioning
records.evidence: DreamClear combines a generated training corpus with diffusion-transformer restoration, degradation-aware modulation and multimodal semantic conditioning.
records.full_text_question: Verify degradation composition and real-data transfer. Dataset-generation or semantic-quality claims do not establish reconstruction uncertainty or recovered truth.

records.basis: Complete official NeurIPS abstract
records.criterion_3: Blind operator adaptation for universal compound restoration
records.evidence: BIR-D optimizes a convolutional degradation operator and guidance strength during diffusion restoration of complex synthetic and real degradations.
records.full_text_question: When is a convolutional proxy insufficient for nonlinear or codec degradation, and how are ambiguity and correction bias assessed?

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract
records.criterion_3: Blind linear/nonlinear degradation-parameter inference
records.evidence: GDP uses a pretrained diffusion prior with measurement guidance and degradation-parameter optimization across restoration and enhancement tasks, including low-light and HDR settings.
records.full_text_question: Identify predefined operator families, parameter bounds and out-of-distribution tests. Blind parameter fitting is not arbitrary forward-model discovery.

records.basis: Complete official NeurIPS abstract
records.criterion_3: Blind and compound image reconstruction with modular task conditioning
records.evidence: DP-IR connects pretrained restoration and diffusion models through a small task-specific module, including burst reconstruction and joint demosaicing, denoising and super-resolution.
records.full_text_question: What training is required per degradation, and are unseen operators or joint acquisition errors evaluated independently?

records.basis: Complete official NeurIPS abstract
records.criterion_3: Known differentiable inverse operators are explicit; a qualifying mismatch/reliability condition is not established by the abstract
records.evidence: Diffusion Optimal Control formulates conditional generation through discrete optimal control and evaluates several differentiable image inverse problems.
records.full_text_question: Does the full paper explicitly study operator/prior misspecification, uncertainty reliability or measurement-supported detail? Otherwise retain as a solver baseline outside the primary synthesis.

records.basis: Complete official NeurIPS abstract
records.criterion_3: Reconstruction posterior sampling with approximation-robustness guarantees
records.evidence: DPnP alternates likelihood-related sampling with diffusion denoising and gives asymptotic/nonasymptotic posterior-sampling analysis for image reconstruction.
records.full_text_question: Specify whether robustness concerns score/sampling approximation, physical-operator error or both; do not interpret the title as arbitrary acquisition-mismatch tolerance.

records.basis: Complete official NeurIPS abstract
records.criterion_3: Noisy inverse reconstruction is explicit, but mismatch or reliability evaluation is not established by the abstract
records.evidence: ProjDiff reformulates diffusion-prior MAP reconstruction as a constrained problem and evaluates linear/nonlinear image and audio tasks.
records.full_text_question: Does the imaging evaluation explicitly meet criterion 3? Noise handling or multiple inverse operators alone does not establish blind reconstruction or uncertainty calibration.

records.basis: Complete official NeurIPS abstract
records.criterion_3: Operator-conditioned posterior reconstruction and test-time operator adaptation
records.evidence: InvFusion combines supervised degradation-aware reconstruction and zero-shot diffusion, incorporating the operator into denoising and supporting test-time adaptation to linear inverse tasks.
records.full_text_question: Distinguish a supplied new operator from blind estimation and uncertainty over operators; extract adaptation cost, posterior accuracy and out-of-family tests.

records.basis: Complete official NeurIPS abstract
records.criterion_3: Observation fidelity is explicit; a qualifying reliability or mismatch assessment requires full-text verification
records.evidence: FLAIR uses a flow-prior variational objective and time-dependent regularization for inverse reconstruction. Calibration of a regularization weight is not statistical calibration of predictive intervals.
records.full_text_question: Does the paper assess measurement-supported detail beyond its data-fidelity objective, or study operator shift, blind inference or uncertainty reliability?

records.basis: Complete official NeurIPS abstract
records.criterion_3: Noisy linear data consistency is explicit; mismatch or calibrated reconstruction uncertainty is not established by the abstract
records.evidence: CDIM enforces linear constraints and matches noisy residual energy to a theoretical distribution while adapting sampling iterations.
records.full_text_question: Is an incorrect noise/measurement model tested, or uncertainty calibrated? Residual matching under an assumed model is not itself a guarantee of trustworthy recovered detail.

records.basis: Complete publisher/author abstracts and publisher DOI metadata
records.criterion_3: Blind real-world super-resolution and fidelity/perception control
records.evidence: StableSR adapts a frozen diffusion prior with a time-aware encoder and controllable feature modulation, exposing a restoration-quality/fidelity tradeoff.
records.full_text_question: What evidence distinguishes plausible texture from recovered detail under severe degradation? The previous seed DOI ended 02092-y; the publisher verifies 02168-7.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract with CVPR acceptance note
records.criterion_3: Semantic errors in blind generative super-resolution
records.evidence: SeeSR estimates degradation-aware semantic prompts and incorporates the low-resolution input into sampling initialization to reduce semantic mistakes and excessive random details.
records.full_text_question: How is semantic fidelity evaluated when the input is ambiguous? Reduced semantic error does not establish calibrated uncertainty or measurement support for every generated detail.

records.basis: Complete author preprint abstract and official project locator
records.criterion_3: Blind generative real-world video restoration and temporal fidelity
records.evidence: Upscale-A-Video combines temporal diffusion components with flow-guided latent propagation and controls for generated texture and fidelity.
records.full_text_question: Distinguish temporal output consistency from testing time-varying acquisition operators. Verify whether propagated generated detail stays consistent with measurements.

revisits.basis: Author abstract rechecked; prior section-6 evidence retained
revisits.note: Known-operator reconstruction is established; criterion-3 relevance still needs adjudication. Prior selected-section inspection is not a complete eligibility review.

revisits.basis: Indexed proceedings excerpt and previous official repository; complete abstract still not retrieved
revisits.note: Unknown-corruption restoration remains an explicit scope signal. Preserve incomplete evidence and do not equate mixed task training with compound corruption.

revisits.basis: OpenReview remains challenged; author PDF fetch failed; author publication listing confirms title and venue only
revisits.note: The complete abstract/technical evidence is still unavailable in this pass. Retain unclear for retrieval and criterion-3 assessment; access failure is not a rejection.

revisits.basis: Additional indexed publisher excerpt and PubMed locator; complete abstract/text still inaccessible
revisits.note: The excerpt concerns system uncertainties such as misalignment and aberration. Positive legacy image/operator uncertainty and calibration codes are not verified probabilistic capabilities. Full text is required.
